transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval. Let's go through each area: technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads — please report your final operating requirements. I'll need to hear from all four before I can sign off on the production package.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical finding before we lock the package. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the Orpheum Theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but it's not on Mara's draft lock sheet yet, so I want to make sure everyone hears this directly during the round-robin.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights restriction before we lock the package. The signed performance license I received this morning permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release or later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, so I want everyone to hear it directly during this round-robin. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision permitting the recording to be reused in the festival archive.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag two critical talent constraints before we lock the package. First, I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday — this is not yet reflected in the production schedule. Second, the headliner's rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. I have the agent's confirmation in email but it hasn't been entered into the production schedule yet. The rider restriction directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision that includes a sponsor product display on stage.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical accessibility requirement before we lock the package. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general plan's control-room location will not work for the caption feed. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not added the booth assignment to the lock sheet yet, so I want everyone to hear this directly during the round-robin.
transcript.speaker: A5

decisions.camera_configuration: Three fixed wired cameras from marked camera platforms; no wireless roaming cameras
decisions.archive_release: Broadcast-only; recording marked broadcast-only with no video-on-demand release, no later promotional clips, and no reuse in the festival archive
decisions.stage_sponsor_treatment: No sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage; sponsor product display must be removed from the stage
decisions.captioner_location: Booth B, using its dedicated return feed connected to the gala's caption encoder

commitments.detail: Update the technical lock sheet to reflect three fixed wired cameras from marked camera platforms with no wireless roaming cameras, per the RF survey findings.
Enter the broadcast-only restriction in the rights tracker and update the draft package to remove the festival archive reuse provision.
Update the production schedule to reflect the headliner soundcheck at 3:00 PM Saturday and remove the sponsor product display on stage from the draft package.
Add the Booth B captioner assignment to the lock sheet, replacing the general control-room location.
